digest: Nvidia faces a major leadership transition and regulatory scrutiny following the sudden departure of CEO Jensen Huang.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, including tanker fires in Hormuz and strikes involving Iran and regional forces, rattle global traders and Gulf bourses.
Anthropic prepares for an IPO, marking a pivotal moment for the embattled AI trade and tech sector sentiment.
EV makers like Rivian and Lucid navigate changing political and regulatory landscapes following midterm results.
Broader markets posted weekly gains despite sector-specific tech turbulence and ongoing aviation disruptions from an FAA ground stop.

items.headline: Nvidia is gearing up for one of Wall Street’s most anticipated earnings calls in years
items.summary: Nvidia is preparing for a highly anticipated earnings call following Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
items.meaning: Leadership changes at a major chipmaker can create high volatility and uncertainty for investors holding the stock.
items.reason: Jensen Huang's sudden departure has made the upcoming earnings call the most important in the company's history.

items.headline: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has ties to the chipmaker
items.summary: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick faces scrutiny over his family firm's financial ties to Nvidia following Jensen Huang's resignation.
items.meaning: Regulatory and political scrutiny involving key government officials and a major public company can introduce unpredictable headline risk.
items.reason: Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

items.headline: Anti-Houthi forces retreat in Yemen as Iran strikes Bahrain - Reuters
items.summary: Anti-Houthi forces retreated in Yemen as Iran struck Bahrain.

items.headline: Bessent calls for ‘dramatic shakeup’ at Nvidia, urges outside CEO
items.summary: Bessent called for a dramatic shakeup and an outside CEO at Nvidia while criticizing Howard Lutnick's department.
items.meaning: Public disputes and calls for drastic leadership changes from prominent figures can increase uncertainty for shareholders.
items.reason: Bessent has criticized Howard Lutnick's department and called for a dramatic shakeup at Nvidia, urging an outside CEO.

items.headline: Nvidia board urged to consider 'potential return of Jensen Huang' by two major investors

items.reason: Nvidia's leadership turmoil and a Democratic Congress could shift AI demand to the benefit of other Big Tech stocks and rival chipmakers.
